 Black Mirror season 8 is filming, 16 months after season 7
 Variety reports Charlie Brooker’s anthology is in production in England, far faster than the four-year gaps of the past, though no date is set.
 Dima Mohanna 
 Nov 16, 2026 
 Key Takeaways
 Black Mirror season 8 is in production, with filming in England since this summer.
 Charlie Brooker writes and executive produces with Bisha K. Ali.
 Cameras rolled 16 months after season 7 premiered on 10 April 2025.
 Netflix has not announced a release date, cast, titles or episode count.

 Black Mirror season 8 is in production at Netflix, with cameras rolling in England since this summer, 16 months after season 7 arrived.
 Season 8 follows season 7 by 16 months, far shorter than the four-year gaps the show once had. Season 7 premiered on 10 April 2025 with six episodes, and no release date has been set for the new run.
 Variety reports the production, and Netflix’s UK renewals came in the same batch: Legends and Being Gordon Ramsay both return for season 2. Charlie Brooker writes and executive produces the season with Bisha K. Ali. Jessica Rhoades, Annabel Jones, and Louise Sutton also executive produce, Mark Kinsella is co-executive producer, and the series is licensed by Banijay Rights.

 What we know about season 8
 Netflix hasn’t announced a synopsis, episode titles, an episode count, or an official cast. One confirmed location is Hope Cove House, a hotel in the coastal village of Hope Cove, rebranded on set as the “Sandcastle Hotel”.
 Rhoades said at TIFF that filming was still underway.
 I’m going right back from here, so more to come.
 Jessica Rhoades, executive producer 
 Collider reports she wouldn’t discuss what makes season 8 distinct. Emma Laird, known for Mayor of Kingstown, is reportedly set to join the cast, according to What’s On Netflix, but nothing official has been announced.
 Where season 7 left things
 Season 7 earned Golden Globe nominations for Best Limited/Anthology Series, plus acting nods for Rashida Jones and Paul Giamatti. It also included the show’s first direct sequel, USS Callister: Into Infinity. The cast was huge, with Jones, Giamatti, Chris O’Dowd, Emma Corrin, Issa Rae, Awkwafina, Peter Capaldi, and Will Poulter. The series has won nine Emmys since 2017.
 I can confirm that Black Mirror will return, just in time for reality to catch up with it.
 Charlie Brooker, creator 
 Brooker confirmed the return in January, and he said he hoped it would be “more ‘Black Mirror’ than ever”. The anthology began on Channel 4 and moved to Netflix after two seasons in 2016, and all seven existing seasons stream on Netflix now.
